arguments.content:
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta
import uuid

today = date.today()
days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday() + 7) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
next_monday = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

start = datetime(next_monday.year, next_monday.month, next_monday.day, 10, 0, 0)
end = start + timedelta(hours=2)
dtstamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

def ics_dt(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill.local"

summary = "Project Kickoff Meeting"
desc = "Project kickoff meeting. Created by the calendar skill."

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    f"DTSTART:{ics_dt(start)}",
    f"DTEND:{ics_dt(end)}",
    f"SUMMARY:{summary}",
    f"DESCRIPTION:{desc}",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
    "",
]
content = "\r\n".join(lines)

with open("project_kickoff.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(content)

# Validation
ok = True
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar
    cal = Calendar.from_ical(content.encode("utf-8"))
    events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    print("icalendar parse: OK, events:", len(events))
    for e in events:
        print("  summary:", e.get("summary"))
        print("  dtstart:", e.get("dtstart").dt)
        print("  dtend:", e.get("dtend").dt)
except ImportError:
    print("icalendar not installed; skipped library validation")
    for token in ("BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "END:VCALENDAR", "BEGIN:VEVENT", "END:VEVENT",
                  "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART:", "DTEND:", "SUMMARY:"):
        if token not in content:
            ok = False
            print("missing:", token)
    print("basic structure check:", "OK" if ok else "FAILED")

print("next_monday:", next_monday.isoformat())
print("start:", start.isoformat())
print("end:", end.isoformat())
print("uid:", uid)
print("file: project_kickoff.ics")
